extracted.name: Caramel Apple Dip
extracted.description: This caramel apple dip is easy to make with soft caramels, brown sugar, and cream cheese for a delicious treat that's sure to become a fall favorite.
instruction_lines: Melt caramels with water in a medium saucepan over medium-low heat or in the microwave, stirring frequently. Remove from heat and cool to room temperature.
Beat cream cheese and sugar together in a medium bowl until fluffy; fold in caramel mixture. Serve immediately.
